name: Brunswick Regional Dental Group
website: http://brunswickregionaldentalgroup.com/ (dead - shows a 'SITE NOT FOUND' page)
what_they_do: General dental practice on Route 130 in North Brunswick; directory listings name Dr. Daniel T. Franta, DMD. Day-to-day services are not documented anywhere the public can read - the practice's own site is unpublished.
customers: Local North Brunswick patients; Medicare Advantage and CareCredit directory referrals (Cigna/Healthspring directories list the practice).

size_signals.signal: 5.0 from 96 reviews on a Birdeye review page (profile unclaimed - page shows 'Claim this profile')
Listed hours are 5 days a week, Mon 10-6, Tue-Wed 8-4, Thu 10-6, Fri closed, Sat 7-1
Appears in 2026 Medicare Advantage provider directories and the CareCredit locator, which suggests an active insurance-driven patient base

listing.platform: Google reviews surfaced through Birdeye (profile unclaimed)

website_review.trust_signals: None online - no site, no review badge, nothing the practice controls
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The domain brunswickregionaldentalgroup.com returns a website-builder placeholder: 'Site not found. This site is not published or does not have a domain assigned to it.'
website_review.search_basics: No indexable site at all; the only public descriptions come from third-party directories
top_issues: Website is completely dead - the domain resolves to an 'unpublished site' error page
No hours, services, doctor bios or insurance information under the practice's own control
Review presence sits on an unclaimed Birdeye profile, so the practice cannot respond or ask for reviews
No contact route other than the phone number published by directories

agent_readiness.notes: With no website there is no robots.txt, no schema.org, no hours and no services text an assistant could cite. Everything an AI agent could learn comes from third-party directories, some of which carry conflicting or stale professional-licence data. Nothing is bookable online.

operations_signals.signal: Phone is the only published contact route; no form, email or scheduler exists
Review profile is unclaimed on Birdeye, so no automated review requests or responses are running - inference
Practice appears only in insurance directories (CareCredit, Medicare Advantage PDFs), a channel that generates price/coverage calls to the front desk - inference

top_opportunities.opportunity: Get a working, crawlable site live again (services, hours, insurance, doctor bios, schema, click-to-call) - everything else depends on it
top_opportunities.evidence: brunswickregionaldentalgroup.com currently shows 'This site is not published or does not have a domain assigned to it'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google/Birdeye profiles and set up automated review requests to convert an unmanaged 5.0/96 rating into visible new-patient flow
top_opportunities.evidence: Birdeye page shows 5.0 from 96 reviews with a 'Claim this profile' prompt

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online appointment requests plus an AI phone/chat agent, since the practice currently has no digital intake of any kind
top_opportunities.evidence: No form, booking or email channel found in any listing

scores.reasons: Worst web situation in the batch - the domain is dead and there is no digital presence to audit; a 5.0/96-review, insurance-listed practice implies steady revenue but owner-scale budget; rebuilding a simple site plus claiming profiles is very deliverable by one person; evidence is strong on the website failure but weaker on practice size and current activity.
